body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended.) A landing gear for an aircraft comprising:at least a nose gear disposed longitudinally forward of a center of gravity of an aircraft by a first distance and connected to a nose linkage configured to transfer movement from the at least a nose gear to at least a main gear;
at least a main gear disposed longitudinally aft of the center of gravity of the aircraft by a second distance and connected to a main linkage configured to transform movement from the at least a main gear to the at least a nose gear; and
wherein the at least a nose gear and the at least a main gear are mechanically linked using a longitudinal member, wherein the longitudinal member comprises a tension cable.
2. (Original.) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the landing gear is further configured to permit an increase in an angle of attack of the aircraft during take-off.
3. (Original.) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the landing gear is further configured to permit a decrease in an angle of attack of the aircraft during landing.
4. (Original.) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the at least a main gear is located aft of at least a portion of a passenger compartment.
5. (Original.) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the at least a nose gear is located at the nose of the aircraft.
6. (Original.) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the at least a nose gear is connected to a pivot piston.
7. (Currently Amended.) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein [[a]]the longitudinal member mechanically links the nose linkage and the main linkage.
8. (Cancelled.)
9. (Currently Amended.) The landing gear of claim 1, wherein the at least a nose gear and the at least a main gear are housed within the aircraft comprises a blended wing body (BWB).
10. (Original.) The landing gear of claim 1, further configured to form a tricycle arrangement.
11. (Currently Amended.) A method of using a landing gear for an aircraft comprising:disposing at least a nose gear forward of the center of gravity of an aircraft by a first distance;
disposing at least a main gear aft of the neutral point of the aircraft by a second distance;
transferring movement between the at least a nose gear and the at least a main gear through a mechanical linkage between a nose linkage and a main linkage, using a longitudinal member, wherein the longitudinal member comprises a tension cable.
12. (Original.) The method of claim 11, wherein the landing gear is further configured to permit an increase in an angle of attack of the aircraft during take-off.
13. (Original.) The method of claim 11, wherein the method is further configured to permit a decrease in an angle of attack of the aircraft during landing.
14. (Original.) The method of claim 11, wherein the at least a main gear is located aft of at least a portion of a passenger compartment.
15. (Original.) The method of claim 11, wherein the at least a nose gear is located at the nose of the aircraft.
16. (Original.) The method of claim 11, wherein the at least a nose gear is connected to a pivot piston.
17. (Currently Amended.) The method of claim 11, wherein [[a]]the longitudinal member mechanically links the nose linkage and the main linkage.
18. (Cancelled.)
19. (Original.) The method of claim 11, wherein the at least a nose gear and the at least a main gear are housed within the aircraft comprises a blended wing body (BWB).
20. (Original.) The method of claim 11, further configured to form a tricycle arrangement.
